positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, developed and maintained desktop-based test automation software for Android and Linux-based Texas Instruments OMAP development platforms.
- Developed and maintained a domain-specific language for automated testing of Android and Linux based systems from the command line
- Developed multimedia capture software to assist with automated validation and benchmarking
- Worked with a team to design, deploy and maintain a web-based validation architecture for large scale testing and reporting for development platforms using a variety of languages, including Ruby on Rails, Jenkins, Perl and Java.
- Supported and trained users of test automation software
- Primary responsibility for the training and support of two interns in June 2012

positions.title: Application Development Co-op
positions.description:
- Worked with a team to build a football prediction game with several prizes in C#, ASP.NET 2.0, and SQL Server 2005
- Worked with another intern to implement a whole-site redesign.
- Implemented changes to statistics tracking capabilities of the football game simulation engine.

positions.title: Application Development Co-op
positions.description:
- Designed, developed and maintained web applications for college enrollment, course registration, surveys, software license management and student graduation using C#, ASP.NET 2.0 and SQL Server.
- Maintained departmental applications using Classic ASP, SQL Server,
ColdFusion, C# and VB.NET.
